answer: Cosignatures are collected in meadow, verified in dune, and lagoon names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 18 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. The attacker spends 250 dollars and 9 days per identity before it can vote at all. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
